summary: Sweeping pixel radar where each service node lights up as the beam passes; Ping sends out a ring that flashes every node it touches.

events.name: ping
events.description: Fires when the Ping button is pressed.

keyboard.action: Select the next node and show its tooltip.
Select the previous node and show its tooltip.

accessibility: The canvas is focusable with `role="img"` and `aria-label="Radar of 6 service nodes. Arrow keys step through them."`.

The node tooltip is drawn for pointer and sighted keyboard users; a visually hidden `aria-live="polite"` region announces each node stepped to with the arrow keys, for example "edge-tokyo · 131 ms · degraded". Blurring the canvas clears the selection.
The summary ("6 nodes · 1 degraded") is an `aria-live="polite"` region. Ping is a native button.
motion: With reduced motion, the beam stays at a fixed angle, nodes stop drifting and keep a steady brightness and the selection ring does not turn; the ping ring still expands.
notes: The nodes are built-in demo data: api-eu-1 (42 ms), api-us-2 (88 ms), edge-tokyo (131 ms, degraded), worker-7 (27 ms), db-primary (9 ms) and queue-3 (64 ms).
The radar is a fixed 232 by 232px and animates continuously while on screen, except under reduced motion.

data.note: The six service nodes and their latencies are invented; nothing can be set.
